observer.note: The archived observer preserves the exact mixed line endings used during the frozen study. The tracked executable differs only by LF normalization required by repository attributes.

method: Check out the source commit in a separate directory. Gunzip the archived observer into evolving_drift/tools/benchmark-observed.cjs. First run that checkout's benchmark-evolution.cjs for 80 evaluations per variant with --out all-vehicle-s37-<vehicleId>; these prerequisite reports are required by the observer's exact first-80 parity check. Then run the observer with seed 37, track kr-kic-t21-kdl-2016-r2, workers 2, budget 400 for ten variants or 1000 for the six selected variants. The first 400 prefixes form the all-16 matched comparison; do not add overlapping checkpoints. The prerequisite 16 x 80 runs are separate from the extended 10000-candidate budget.
prepared: Only checked-in Prepared.load genesis; no discovered gene is supplied to search.
sourceHashCaveat: Historical raw source byte hashes reflect the frozen Windows checkout; use the reported physics/fitness/genome signatures and exact gene/result parity when checkout line endings differ.
